authority: Thomas (2025) dissertation; original bytes protected by source-integrity.json

input.benchmark_note: No final historical human benchmark is asserted. Research requires independently annotated labels; generated fixtures are not human annotations.
input.discovery: discovery_input_csv if set, otherwise input_csv; Study 1 default is 704 archived lockdown texts
input.analysis: input_csv; Study 1 default is 5,871 nonempty records; full.csv retains 5,872

naming.system: You are an expert at naming topics.
naming.user_template: The following words represent a topic derived from {domain}: {words}. Please provide a concise, meaningful topic name that clearly summarizes these words.

classification.system: You are an expert at classifying text into themes.
classification.user_template: Classify the following text into one of the following {N} themes: {numbered_options}.Text: {document}.Respond with verbatim classification using only the specified {N} options.
classification.none_label: The text does not fit into any of these themes

human_checkpoint: Two researchers review and record a topic-to-theme map. Agents must not invent review or consensus.

gate.per_theme: positive benchmark support and nonzero sensitivity required; inspect precision and recall and justify acceptance for the study

statistics.multiplicity: alpha / (number of themes × number of pairs)

reproduction_limit: Topic models and LLMs include probabilistic steps. A fresh run can group or label some posts differently, especially when the random seed, model, or software version changes. The goal is an illustrative original-data rerun, not identical historical output replication.

quickcheck.purpose: Verify original Study 1 hashes, cohort preparation and counts

review_record.decision: approved for human research; synthetic-test-only for oracle fixture

budget.public_demo: Released Study 1 example IDs only; 200/session/day; 600/IP/day; USD20/day and USD620/calendar month site-wide, shared with the research guide

research_guide.sources: dissertation page excerpts and public repository
research_guide.execution: explanation only; cannot access visitor files or execute research
research_guide.limits: Shared public 200/session/day; 600/IP/day; USD20/day and USD620/calendar month (UTC)

public_service.data: released Study 1 brand records only; Study 2 user data excluded
